newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Lisbon bourse PSI20 index drops 2.22 pct.
newsitem.headline: Lisbon bourse PSI20 index drops 2.22 pct.

text.p: The PSI20 index fell 2.22 percent in early trade as profit-taking set in after the recent powerful surge in prices, dealers said.
The selling was hitting most blue chips, with Banco Totta & Acores down over four percent.
The index was subsequently recovering some ground, being down 1.8 percent at 7,950.35 points at 10.07 GMT.
But prices carried on the Reuter system are subject to delays due to technical problems with the feed from the Lisbon bourse.
